_about: Retrieval eval set for Memex, run against a BILINGUAL corpus: the English bundled sample vault (sample_vault::SAMPLE_NOTES, 51 pages) plus the Korean parallel fixture on disk (eval/ko-corpus/, 20 pages), indexed into one store by examples/retrieval_eval.rs. Queries are labeled with the wiki page stem(s) that should be retrieved (Korean queries -> ko-* stems). Three groups: (1) Phase-0 English semantic paraphrases + exact-term/acronym; (2) Phase-1b Korean semantic + exact-term (Korean queries against Korean docs -- the CJK lexical overlap the BM25 arm exploits; dense alone tends to confuse the parallel EN page); (3) Phase-1b hard English exact tokens present in exactly one page (QLoRA/PPO/RLAIF/...), where dense under-weights rare strings. Phase 1a saturated the English-only set at hit@10 100%; groups (2)/(3) re-open measurable headroom for BM25 + RRF. Edit freely; the harness reads this file.
